text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *pant* *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I ran just like they said to, but 
is this really going to—
—Windy-san!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"That run just now was filled with such 
strong resolve— it was truly magnificent."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A first-rate Umamusume must always strive 
with all her might... This really stiffens 
my resolve!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: If you don't mind, would you run with me?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! Even if it's after that, could I 
ask for your help...?!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: (It really is just like the rumors said—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clatter!!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Mmmph...! Don't get in my way!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"To show off how amazing Windy-chan is, 
she needs to stand way higher than 
everyone else!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I was just practicing for that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ? What is the meaning of this?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand! Teach me in more 
detail!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(Nishishi! It was just like Trainer said 
it'd be!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
(When Windy-chan runs with all her might, 
everyone tells her how amazing she is!)

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, looks like that guy's finally 
starting to pull his own weight!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Um, Windy-san? Are you really busy, or—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Windy-chan is totally fine! I'll run even 
more and grab everyone's attention!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Follow meee!!
